结训报告递上去后，很快回复就下来了。

不是按正常流程走的逐级审批，而是直接从上面打回来的单独批示。

温良在办公室里看着那份文件，眉头挑了一下。

批示措辞干脆：同意提前结训，同意破格授衔。

后面还附了一句批注——此类人才，不可拘泥常规。

温良把文件合上，靠在椅背上想了一会儿。

二级警司。

正常流程下，顾承安这种刚转正的新人，撑死了三级警司起步。

但他前面几次任务的功劳折算下来，加上特训期间这份堪称离谱的成绩单，上面直接跳了一级。

这在三处的历史上不是没有过，但上一个享受这种待遇的人，已经是十二年前的事了。

那人现在是其他处的副处长。

看来上面也对他很重视啊！

温良拿起电话，拨了个内线号码。

“后勤，准备一套……”

挂了电话，他从抽屉里拿出两个红色绒面的小盒子，打开看了一眼。

里面分别躺着一枚三等功奖章。

顾承安接到通知，让他换一身常服去基地的处长办公室报到。

七天的特训结束后他被安排在基地里休整了一天，除了睡觉就是发呆，难得清静。

温良的办公室不大，三十来平米，布置简单。一张办公桌，两把椅子，一面书柜，墙上挂了一幅字，很有味儿——“慎独”。

顾承安推门进去的时候，温良已经站在办公桌前面了。

桌上摆着几样东西：一套崭新的肩章，两个证件夹，两个红色的小盒子，还有一份文件。

整个办公室里，就他们两个人。

“关上门。”温良说。

顾承安乖乖的把门关上。

然后走到办公桌前，敬了个警礼。

“处长好！”

温良回礼后没有急着开口，而是先把那份文件递给他。

顾承安接过来，低头看扫一遍。

上面的内容不多，关键信息他一眼就抓住了——

“经上级批准，顾承安同志提前结束特别培训，正式转为在编干警。鉴于其在前几次事件中的突出贡献及培训期间的优异表现，特批破格授予二级警司警衔。”

落款处盖着国安局的公章。

After submitting the training report, the reply came quickly.

It is not a step-by-step approval process according to the normal process, but a separate approval directly from above.

Wen Liang looked at the document in the office and raised his eyebrows.

The instructions were simply worded: agree to end training in advance and agree to be awarded an unusual title.

There is also a note at the end - this kind of talent cannot stick to routine.

Wen Liang closed the document and leaned back in his chair to think for a while.

Superintendent II.

Under normal circumstances, a newcomer like Gu Chengan, who had just become a full-time employee, would have to wait until he started as a third-level superintendent.

But after taking into account the credit for his previous missions and this outrageous report card during the special training period, he jumped a level directly.

This is not unprecedented in the history of the three places, but the last person to enjoy this kind of treatment was already twelve years ago.

That person is now the deputy director of another department.

It seems that the higher-ups also attach great importance to him!

Wen Liang picked up the phone and dialed an internal number.

"Logistics, prepare a set..."

After hanging up the phone, he took out two small red velvet boxes from the drawer, opened them and took a look.

Inside each lies a third-class merit medal.

Gu Chengan received a notice and asked him to change into regular clothes and report to the director's office at the base.

After the seven days of special training, he was arranged to rest in the base for a day. He only slept and was in a daze, and it was rare to have peace and quiet.

Wen Liang's office is not big, about thirty square meters, and is simply decorated.There is a desk, two chairs, a bookcase, and a picture hanging on the wall, which is very interesting - "Be careful in being alone".

When Gu Chengan pushed the door open and walked in, Wen Liang was already standing in front of the desk.

There are several things on the table: a brand new set of epaulettes, two ID holders, two small red boxes, and a document.

They were the only two people in the entire office.

"Close the door." Wen Liang said.

Gu Chengan obediently closed the door.

Then he walked to the desk and gave a police salute.

"Hello, Director!"

After Wen Liang returned the gift, he didn't rush to speak, but handed him the document first.

Gu Chengan took it and looked down at it.

There wasn't much content on it, but he caught the key information at a glance——

"With the approval of his superiors, Comrade Gu Chengan ended the special training ahead of schedule and officially became a regular police officer. In view of his outstanding contributions in previous incidents and his outstanding performance during the training period, he was specially granted the rank of Second Class Superintendent."

The signature is stamped with the official seal of the National Security Bureau.
